prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished videogame main menu background, wide 16:9 1920x1080 composition. RockStreet, fictional Neon City 1986 rock beat-em-up. Cinematic painted realism with convincing gritty materials, polished 1980s rock album cover atmosphere. Night street outside a small live rock club, wet asphalt reflecting restrained cyan and magenta neon, weathered brick facades, posters without legible text, cables and amplifiers at entrance, thin smoke. At far left third a blond long-haired rocker seen from behind in black leather jacket and jeans with red electric guitar slung over shoulder, looking toward club. Strong depth. Central upper area dark uncluttered sky/building shadow reserved for large game title; bottom center dark open asphalt reserved for four menu options. Detail and light concentrated at side edges. No text, logos, UI, buttons, watermark. Full bleed single landscape image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished videogame backstage upgrade shop background, wide 16:9 composition 1920x1080. RockStreet fictional Neon City 1986. Cinematic painted realism with gritty brick, leather, metal and wood textures, 1980s rock cover aesthetic. Empty backstage rehearsal room and band equipment workshop, warm mirror bulbs near far left edge, electric guitars hanging at far edges, stacked road flight cases and powered guitar amplifier, coiled cables, tools and pedals at perimeter. A sliver of stage entrance at far right casts magenta and cyan light with haze. Camera straight-on wide. Two broad quiet dark brick wall surfaces across middle left and middle right intentionally reserved behind upgrade UI panels, all focal equipment concentrated at top perimeter and bottom corners. Moody inviting refuge, realistic materials, subtle amber warmth. No people, no readable text, no logos, no UI, no watermark. Single full bleed landscape image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: videogame mission selection city map background, wide 16:9 1920x1080. RockStreet Neon City 1986. Cinematic detailed painted realism, elevated bird's-eye isometric urban diorama at night, buildings small enough to show whole city. Ten distinctive landmark districts linked by streets, progression winds left foreground to right background: lower-left garage neighborhood, left-mid small music nightclub alley, lower middle-left arcade, center record shop neighborhood, lower center-right subway station, upper center recording studios, right-mid industrial district and distant huge rock stadium upper-right. Restrained cyan magenta street lights, amber windows, gritty brick rooftops, rail lines, wet roads, atmospheric haze. City occupies middle vertical band from 15% to 75% of frame, top 12% quiet dark night haze reserved for status bar and bottom 23% quiet dark pavement/shadow reserved for mission details. Geographical map readability, distinct blocks, no dominating foreground building. No text, numbers, markers, routes drawn on top, labels, UI, logos or watermark. Single full bleed landscape image.
